    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>I want a podcast about the history of civil uh... rights movements worldwide</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to deep research

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hey, let’s get to work, shall we? generate a podcast from let’s see... the research report</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
            <args></args>
        </response>

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Good evening Einstein, use the podcast creator to make a show about optogenetics and controlling neural circuits with light</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
            <args>topic="optogenetics and controlling neural circuits with light"</args>
        </response>

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Good evening Carla dig deep into the psychology of hold on... creativity and divergent thinking</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
            <args>topic="the psychology of creativity and divergent thinking"</args>
        </response>

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Okay, I need your help, get me comprehensive research on open source intelligence and geopolitical analysis</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
            <args>topic="open source intelligence and geopolitical analysis"</args>
        </response>

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hello My old friend, my esteemed friend, build a podcast on precision agriculture using satellite data okay, so...</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to research to podcast

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hiya, dig deep into the history of cryptography from ancient to modern</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
            <args>topic="the history of cryptography from ancient to modern"</args>
        </response>

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hola Jarvis, qué tal? generate a detailed podcast about circular economy and zero-waste manufacturing</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to deep research

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>deep dive into robotic surgery and haptic feedback systems please</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
            <args>topic="robotic surgery and haptic feedback systems"</args>
        </response>

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hi there Einstein, what’s new? take the paper about climate adaptation and turn it into okay, so... a podcast episode</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
            <args>document_path="the paper about climate adaptation"</args>
        </response>

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hey Carla, ready for today? convert this analysis to a podcast</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to deep research

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hello, ready to get started? uh... convert /research/antibiotic-resistance-patterns.md to a podcast episode</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
            <args>document_path="/research/antibiotic-resistance-patterns.md"</args>
        </response>

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Good morning, ready to start? i want comprehensive research on the ethics of genetic enhancement in humans</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
            <args>topic="the ethics of genetic enhancement in humans"</args>
        </response>

        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.

        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>make i guess... this research into a podcast</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to podcast generator

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hola Old Faithful, transform /docs/review-autonomous-vehicle-safety.txt into an audio ah... podcast</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
            <args>document_path="/docs/review-autonomous-vehicle-safety.txt"</args>
        </response>

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>deeply investigate the geopolitics of lithium and cobalt mining and report back</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to deep research

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>produce a podcast covering robotic surgery and er... haptic feedback systems</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to deep research

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.

        <human>
            <voice-command>My old friend develop a podcast covering quantum computing and its impact on cryptography</voice-command>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
            <args>topic="quantum computing and its impact on cryptography"</args>
        </response>

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Buenas noches My Dear Watson, turn this document um... into a podcast</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to research to podcast

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>generate a podcast episode like... about the history of nuclear weapons proliferation</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to deep research

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:

        <human>
            <voice-command>Good evening, how’s everything? explore polar ice core records and paleoclimatology thoroughly</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
            <args>topic="polar ice core records and paleoclimatology"</args>
        </response>

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Yo Neo, how you doing? make me a podcast on the sociology of aging populations in Japan</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to podcast generator

    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.

        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hey Carla, good to see you. research everything about gravitational wave astronomy okay, so...</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:
